title: Two Sins Leading to Divine War
summary: The hadith discusses two grave sins that provoke Allah's wrath: engaging in usury and showing enmity towards Allah’s friends, which leads to a divine declaration of war against the perpetrator.
translation: There are two sins so dangerous that Allah has stated that if a person is involved in these sins, He declares war against them. One sin is well-known and mentioned in the Quran, which is usury. If you do not desist from dealing in usury, Allah declares war against you. The second matter is mentioned in a hadith narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) where the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, 'Indeed, Allah said: Whoever shows enmity against a friend of Mine, I have declared war against him.' This means that if someone harms one of Allah's close friends or allies, due to the severe hatred of the act, Allah declares war against them. Or it could also mean that enmity against My friend is like enmity against Me, and if someone fights Me, I will declare war against them. Thus, it is clear that no one should show hostility towards Allah's friends, close, or righteous servants. If you cannot benefit them, at least do not harm them. May Allah protect us all.
